messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: global rstan compiler options?
parts:
Hi!

Is it possible to configure compiler options for rstan in a system-wide manner, i.e. similar to make/local from cmdstan? Or is it even possible to define a set of compiler settings which one may refer to with names?

My intention is to install rstan on our cluster with performance geared settings (using MKL & intel compiler) and one for debugging purposes (only intel compiler). Hence, I was wondering if this can be made convenient for all users on the system (without bothering users with these settings apart from telling them the names of the compiler profiles).

Many thanks!

Best,
Sebastian

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: global rstan compiler options?
parts:
On Monday, April 27, 2015 at 7:56:30 AM UTC-4, Sebastian Weber wrote:
Is it possible to configure compiler options for rstan in a system-wide manner, i.e. similar to make/local from cmdstan? Or is it even possible to define a set of compiler settings which one may refer to with names?

You need a file that is pointed to by the environmental variable R_MAKEVARS_SITE that is not trumped by R_MAKEVARS_USER.

Ben
